def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    m = len(state[0])
    next_state = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            cell = state[r][c]
            if r % 2 == 0:  # even row, use E/W neighbors
                W = state[r][c-1] if c > 0 else cell
                E = state[r][c+1] if c < m-1 else cell
                next_state[r][c] = (W + E - cell) % 3
            else:  # odd row, use N/S neighbors
                N = state[r-1][c] if r > 0 else cell
                S = state[r+1][c] if r < n-1 else cell
                next_state[r][c] = (N + S - cell) % 3
    return next_state
